prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Katy, Texas. Injury: whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1146; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was turning left at an intersection in Katy, Texas, when another vehicle struck the driver's side of my car. The impact pushed me against the door and jolted my head and neck forward and back. I stopped my car right away, stayed at the scene until the other driver and I exchanged information, and then called for help. I have described what happened the same way every time I have spoken about it, whether to the officer at the scene, to my insurer, or to the medical staff. I am the named driver on this policy and was operating my own vehicle with permission from no one else. Since the collision I have had neck stiffness, headaches, and pain between my shoulder blades, which I have been treating with a doctor's care and physical therapy.
